what: A MOUNTING boot of the real dsh-tui 0.12.0 in an isolated sandbox (DSH_HOME + HOME + sandboxed workspace cwd), proving the three claims this lane rests on.

sandbox.workspace: <root>/ws (passed explicitly as DSH_TUI_WORKSPACE_TARGET; the session record's cwd proves it took effect)
sandbox.profile: <root>/dshhome/profiles/dsh-tui — a COPY of the real TUI profile with node_modules/@mpd-dsh/mpd re-pointed at this checkout; the real profile was only READ
sandbox.how_booted: tmux (the TUI refuses a non-TTY stdout) + `tmux pipe-pane` for the raw log; a session created by sending Enter to the session list
sandbox.pruned: The copied profile node_modules (69 MB), the sandbox HOME pnpm/npm .cache (63 MB) and the sandbox .codegraph index were REMOVED after the runs to keep the committed evidence small; every boot artifact (logs, panes, session records, the profile manifest + its cordis.patch.yml + the @mpd-dsh link) is kept. Copy contents: profile-copy-contents.txt.

arm_a_preset_row_still_registers.claim: After removing the two host-row id-targets, the bundle's `mpd` preset row is composed and a session mounts it.
witnesses: `dsh --profile dsh-tui --dump-config` in the sandbox composes exactly one preset row: `- id: preset-mpd` / `name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'`
THE SAME DUMP ALSO SHOWS the host's own `dsh-tui-agent-preset-registry` row still present with `default: standard` — i.e. the host row is untouched by this bundle, which is the point of the removal
the sandbox TUI boot mounted the bundle rows and rendered its status line `mpd: team - · plans 0 · workmates 0`

arm_b_mounted_module_absent.claim: The new `mpd-tui-adapter` row is a plain insert and does NOT take the boot down while its dist is unbuilt.
arm_b_mounted_module_absent.measured: `dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate` + `mpd-tui-adapter (@mpd-dsh/mpd/packages/mpd-tui-adapter-plugin/dist/index.js): failed to import` — the TUI still booted and the session still ran. Same line in the web-profile lane (evidence/preset-default/preset-conformance/harness-boot.log lines 17-18).
arm_b_mounted_module_absent.correction: This contradicts the initial assumption that an unresolvable module is a boot-fatal `assertEntriesLoaded` condition; the cordis.patch.yml comment was updated to the measured behaviour.
arm_b_mounted_module_absent.note: This arm is the state DURING lane A build-out; it is superseded by arm_a_after_lane_a_dist above and kept because it is the measurement behind the cordis.patch.yml comment.

arm_b_user_setting_resolves_mpd.claim: With the user-level setting applied (`~/.dsh-tui/agent-preset.json` inside the sandbox HOME) a NEW TUI session RESOLVES `mpd`.
arm_b_user_setting_resolves_mpd.how_applied: THIS LANE'S OWN HELPER: `node scripts/set-default-preset.ts --home <sandbox>/home --profile dsh-tui --yes` wrote 21 bytes `{\n  \"preset\": \"mpd\"\n}` (see apply-pref.log)
arm_b_user_setting_resolves_mpd.witness: the harness's own session record in the sandbox store: `agentPreset: "mpd"`, `cwd: <sandbox>/ws`, sessionId 529e3784-4b14-431d-95bc-40c0a1e952a4 (arm-b-headers.json, arm-b-mpd.pane.txt)

arm_c_setting_absent_falls_back.claim: With the setting absent, the failure is the documented `agent-preset/not-found` for `standard`.
arm_c_setting_absent_falls_back.witness: the harness's own session record: `agentPreset: "standard"`, `cwd: <sandbox>/ws`, sessionId 182125d0-68ad-427e-88c6-293a3119a8dd — i.e. the session does NOT run mpd, it asks for the host default
why_that_is_a_not_found: `--dump-config` proves this composition declares NO `standard` preset row (its only preset row is `preset-mpd`), and dsh-tui 0.12.0 ships only `presets/liangshen`
the registry's own `lib/index.js` raises `RemoteError("agent-preset/not-found", "Unknown agent preset: ${wanted}")` for an id it has no record for

dsh-tui's `composePreset` catches that and warns `dsh-tui: agent preset (default) unavailable (<message>) — composing the session without a preset`, which is why the session still starts (without the mpd composition) instead of failing loudly
arm_c_setting_absent_falls_back.measurement_limit: The WARN LINE ITSELF was not captured: it is erased by the TUI's alternate-screen switch and is not written to any file in the sandbox. The two quoted sources plus the recorded `agentPreset: standard` are the evidence; the warn text is quoted from dsh-tui's source, not from a captured log.

workspace_isolation.asserted: every session record found under <sandbox>/dshhome/sessions is filed under the SANDBOX project key `--home-…-sandbox-ws--`, and its cwd is <sandbox>/ws
workspace_isolation.measured_leak_first_run: the FIRST boot (before DSH_TUI_WORKSPACE_TARGET was set) created sessions under the REAL-repo project key and wrote `<repo>/.mpd/logs` + `<repo>/.codegraph` (gitignored scratch). The sandbox was then reset and every arm re-run with the explicit workspace target.
workspace_isolation.what_the_sandbox_isolates: DSH_HOME (session store), HOME (~/.dsh-tui preference file), workspace state (<sandbox>/ws/.mpd), and the credentials/settings copies the boot needs

arm_a_after_lane_a_dist.claim: Re-run once Lane A built packages/mpd-tui-adapter-plugin/dist/index.js: the adapter row ACTIVATES and a new TUI session still resolves mpd.
arm_a_after_lane_a_dist.measured: the boot log carries ZERO "did not activate" lines (grep count 0, previously 1) and no mpd-tui-adapter import failure, and the session record reads agentPreset: "mpd" (sessionId 529e3784-… re-created; see arm-b2-mpd-adapter-active.log)

arm_d_second_registry_row_probe.claim: The additive workaround the docs rule out (a SECOND registry row) cannot take over the deployment default.
arm_d_second_registry_row_probe.how: a temporary --patch overlay (second-registry.patch.yml, bundle-private entry id mpd-second-registry-probe, name @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry, config.default: mpd) applied to the same sandbox TUI profile; never a shipped layer
arm_d_second_registry_row_probe.measured: dsh-tui reports it against the second row: `mpd-second-registry-probe (@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry): Error: service "agentPresets" has been registered at <AgentPresetRegistry>` plus a cordis Fiber stack (cordis/lib/index.js:813). The row never activates and the composition continues: the TUI still booted and loaded a session.
arm_d_second_registry_row_probe.correction: This is a ROW-level failure, not a whole-boot abort. The docs were corrected from "hard cordis boot error" to the measured wording in both languages.

doc_reconciliation.when: 2026-10-02, after the captain asked for the measured wording
doc_reconciliation.changed: both docs now state (a) the session starts and its record reads agentPreset: "standard"; (b) no mpd composition is applied; (c) the not-found MESSAGE is source-quoted, not observed, and was NOT captured in four boots (raw byte grep: unavailable/Unknown agent preset/not-found/composing the session = 0 hits each, with positive controls proving the method); (d) the second-registry row fails at ROW level with the quoted cordis error.
